messages:
mike: Quick heads-up — I pushed a tiny PR that updates the private-installer README with a clearer preflight checklist and a networking sanity check. https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/432
laura: saw it, thanks. the firewall table link 404s though (anchor mismatch).
mike: ahhh, good catch — I must've renamed the section and forgot the anchor. will fix in a follow-up commit.
anna: while you're at it, can we also add an explicit note about apt/yum mirror considerations for air-gapped installs? we had a customer stumble on missing apt proxies.
sam: I can add a sentence. also the current KMS SDK snippet in the doc doesn't show proxy usage or timeout handling — maybe include a tiny Python example?
laura: yes please, keep it tiny (4–6 lines) and show `proxy=` and `timeout=`. most readers copy-paste.
sam: draft snippet below — feel free to trim:
```python
from redwood_sdk import KMSClient
client = KMSClient(url="https://kms.internal", proxy="http://10.0.0.1:3128", timeout=10)
print(client.get_key("project-main-key"))
```
laura: looks good. add a short comment about using the internal CA cert or `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` for apt/proxy certs.
mike: also noticed the installer doc lists port 8200 for the agent, but our system actually listens on 8201 after the last release — that discrepancy could break customers. I updated the PR description.
anna: thanks for flagging. I added an inline comment pointing to the release note that changed the default.
docs-bot: PR #432 updated: file rename (preflight -> preflight-checklist), added KMS snippet, fixed apt note.
laura: assign reviewers @sam @mike please. trying to get this into docs patch release tomorrow.
sam: reviewing now, small grammar nit and one suggestion to reword the apt proxy paragraph to 'configure mirror + certs' to avoid implying we manage mirrors.
mike: LGTM once port gets corrected to 8201. also add a cross-link to the migration guide for HSM users — they need the PKCS11 path change info.
anna: I'll open a follow-up PR for HSM migration checklist items and a systemd example for PKCS11 env.
sam: sample systemd snippet I recommend including:
```ini
[Service]
Environment=PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
Environment=PKCS11_PIN=1234
ExecStart=/usr/bin/redwood-installer --use-hsm
```
laura: perfect, that addresses the most common confusion. thanks everyone. merging in ~1h unless objections :thumbsup:
mike: one more tiny follow-up: add an explicit sentence about verifying `iptables -L` (or nft) rules on the bastion after install. small ops check.
anna: added that to the migration checklist PR.
laura: great. will include a changelog excerpt in the release notes.
